primary_paper.title: When, Where, and How Experience Becomes Structure: Mechanisms for Recursive Self-Improvement in LLM Agents
primary_paper.scale: 40 项代表性研究全景 + 20 个更新闭环对照（文献分类，非实验样本）
primary_paper.contribution_type: 分类学与分析框架，不产出自己的实验统计量

three_questions.When: 交互证据何时触发更新、何时支持保留、何时值得修订或退役
three_questions.Where: 干预应作用于哪个组件——Prompt/Memory/Skill/Harness 或协同多个
three_questions.How: 证据如何转化为可复用修改、如何针对回归验证、如何整合供后续使用

four_components.Prompt: 直接纳入上下文的内容（指令/示例）——无检索步骤
four_components.Memory: 按条件检索的记录——有检索步骤，文本/介质/时长不决定分类
four_components.Skill: 被 agent 选择并执行的可复用流程——含适用条件/步骤/结果检查
four_components.Harness: 上下文组装、工具调度、执行编排、行为检查——可管理前三者
four_components.key_line: The four categories represent functional roles of editable agent state, distinguished by how retained content affects execution rather than by mutually exclusive software modules

seven_functions.critical_distinction: Evaluate 评估已有执行、为更新提供证据；Verify 检验候选改动。二者目的不同，不可混用
seven_functions.modality: 分析工具而非固定顺序的强制步骤；方法可合并、省略、或在使用后才测试

key_verdict_quotes: Reuse in later tasks alone does not establish that recursive dependency.
Using earlier experience in another update does not by itself prove that the update method has become more effective.
Failure alone does not specify what to edit; the system must analyze what happened.
Both external updates and parameter changes may affect results, so the gains of the combined system cannot all be attributed to one external component.
Better final task performance may result from better components, different candidate selection, or additional search; the number of rounds alone does not identify which factor produced the gain.
Determining whether an improvement process is more effective requires examining later update outcomes and what else changed.
figure3_survives: a component retained for later tasks
a change to the process that produces updates
honesty_signals: 反复使用 'does not by itself prove' / 'alone does not establish' 自我限定
Figure5 明确标注 NR（该loop未报告该function），区分'未报告'与'研究缺最终评估'
9.2 主动指出组合系统收益不可归因给单一外部组件
9.4 区分 Harness2(仅经验库变化,规则固定) / VERSE / SePO(两阶段不并发演化)，不夸大任一为完整RSI
§10.6 主动声明目的性抽样、不估计流行率、分类未经独立双编码——比§9的自我限定更根本的信度自曝

evaluation_comparisons_table7: Update effect: before/after on same tasks
Use across tasks: new tasks or different models/tools
Repeated updates: later updates with/without retained experience
Improvement method: different versions from same starting point
section10_key_findings.candidate_selection_vs_final_eval: SkillOpt用selection set选候选、test set报最终结果；Self-Harness的held-out轨迹对proposer隐藏但分数仍参与选择——编辑器可用的信息不同，解释结果时必须区分
reliability_security: evaluator改变则分数随标准变；须记录evaluator版本与可用信息
多个model judge可能共享错误，数量本身不保证独立判断
恶意内容可进入Memory/Skills后被检索/调用/生成新改动（SKILL-INJECT, SkillGuardBench）
报告实际执行的检查比单一聚合安全分数更有信息量
self_declared_limitations: purposeful selection, supports qualitative comparison, does not estimate prevalence of designs
classification depends on particular use analyzed; not independently double-coded
seven stages are analytical tool; unreported operation does not establish system never uses it
component/stage mappings need examination on further systems

secondary_narrative.source_isolation: 仅叙事层，不作论文有效性证据

covers_section10_11_gist.independent_validation: 任务得分提高只说明更新在当前设置有帮助；要证明继承经验让后续改进更有效，需在相同起点/任务/反馈/计算预算下对照有无经验时产生的后续修改，并用未参与候选筛选的任务检验效果
covers_section10_11_gist.long_term: 跨组件归因（过期记忆/缺失步骤/不完善参数检查同时致因）、长期维护（合并/修订/退役/回滚及维护成本）

secondary_narrative.narrative_framing: 标题'Agent如何越用越强'为传播性措辞；正文对论文框架转述忠实、无明显夸张

coverage_audit.note: 用完整一手原文核对二手转述后，发现二手遗漏了以下重要一手内容——这正是'全文到手前不可下最终结论'的实证
omitted_by_secondary: §10.3 评估可靠性与安全性：环境奖励/测试程序/LLM判定/人工审核观察的信息不同；多个LLM judge会共享错误，数量不等于独立判断；记忆/技能投毒攻击(SKILL-INJECT, SkillGuardBench)
§10.6 论文自曝局限：目的性抽样(purposefully)、不估计设计流行率、分类未经独立双编码(not independently double-coded)
§10.2 维护成本：更新/验证/人工审核/回滚消耗资源，组件越多检索选择负担越大(HarnessPro保留不同权衡的候选版本)
§10.5 可复现性：需记录每轮edit、候选选择、各阶段可用数据；组件版本与编辑历史
coverage_audit.framework_link: 二手忠实但不完整——若只靠二手就会漏掉信度/安全性这两个高价值判据；印证'一手优先'原则

lineage_contamination.note: 来源隔离的关键补充：本次论证者(我方)的 L1/L2/L3 证据阶梯判据，在 §34 已受 lobehub/awesome-rsi 的 Task/Retained/Improver gain taxonomy 影响
lineage_contamination.consequence: 本论文 Figure3 的三种 survives 与我方证据阶梯高度同构——这不是相互独立验证，而是同谱系。此'印证'力度须打折，不可当作独立佐证
lineage_contamination.framework_link: 触发≠真相：长得像≠相互独立验证；确认偏误风险须显式标注

structural_observation: 论文是综述/分类学，贡献是'统一语言'而非新实证发现——须防主体错位：把'提出好框架'读成'证明RSI有效'
论文大量使用 'does not by itself prove' 自我限定，诚实度高，与 §34 SIM 论文同属克制型一手来源
论文自身的核心判据（reuse≠recursive、rounds≠effectiveness、组合收益不可单归因）与本框架 §27/§33/§34 高度一致——但这些一致部分可能是谱系同源，非独立验证
